evidence.actual: AADSTS50011: The redirect URI 'https://app.example.com/callback/' specified in the request does not match the redirect URIs configured for the application

evidence.note: Registered URI has no trailing slash; the request sent one. Redirect URI matching is exact.

output.fix: Make the redirect_uri sent in the authorization request exactly match a registered one. Either remove the trailing slash in the app's request (https://app.example.com/callback) or register https://app.example.com/callback/ in the app registration as an additional URI. Keep exact string matching and don't use wildcards. Use the same value in the token request.

alternatives.why_not: The error text names the redirect URI specifically, and the request and registered values differ only by a trailing slash.
